title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode8 When You Smile

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hmm... Mr. Key, Mr. Key...
Come out, come out wherever you are!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's gotten so dark. Finding it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
N-No, it won't...
Also, we need to be careful not to trip and fall...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-S-S-Something cold just grazed my face...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's just a leaf...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Take a look at this branch.
It hangs down to about your face, Mochizuki, and it's waving in the breeze.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
This is so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We can hold hands if you're feeling scared, Honami! Here, nice and tight!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, this day's ending with quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it is...
I hope we find that key soon...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I kinda like this since we basically get to do another test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You seem to be smiling for real now, Asahina! That makes me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
N-No, wait...! I meant...! Uhhhhhh...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I notice sometimes how you'll smile, but it doesn't seem like a real smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And especially recently, you've seemed sad despite having a smile on your face. Which started to worry me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But...!
I feel a lot better because you seem to be smiling for real now...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why does me having a real smile make you happy, Otori?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I can't help but feel excited when I see you smiling for real, and that makes me smile too!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...
I'm not sure I follow your reasoning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I understand how Emu feels.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's hard not to feel happy when you see someone you care about smile.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want you to feel what I did. I want you to smile the way I did back then.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Otori and Mochizuki care about how I feel, just like Kanade?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What's wrong?!
Is everything okay, Honami?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-Th-Th-The grass just rustled...!
And something ran by...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what if it was a ghost?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Where'd it go?!
Do you think it's gone now?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, I think it's still there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you think it lives on this mountain? Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's something caught on its tail!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, look!
There's a string or something wrapped around its tail.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...!
I think that's the key to the storeroom.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I first borrowed it, I remember seeing a lanyard attached to it. A red one just like that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, we need to get it back!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stay really still for us, Mr. Tanuki...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. It looks so happy now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But how'd this get wrapped around its tail?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It may've gotten caught on its tail after the head priest dropped the key.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Still, I'm glad we found it.
We probably never would have if that tanuki decided to disappear into the woods.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
True...
Hehe. That makes us very lucky.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Now let's tell Mizuki and the others the good news, then head back to the shrine!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heave-ho, heave-ho...
That's the chairs returned to the storeroom...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Phew...
Is that everything we needed to put back?

rows.Speaker: Head Priest
rows.Line:
Yes, I just need to lock the doors now...
Thank you all very much for your help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, thank you for having us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's gotten very late.
Shall we start heading out, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, this is really it for our test of courage...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, saying goodbye to this place isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot to say something really important!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You came up with this idea, right?
I had so much fun making costumes and scaring everybody.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I know I was playing a monster, but seeing everyone smile filled me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was frightened at the thought of a test of courage, but your idea made it fun for all of us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's because you put so much thought and effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. But this was only possible because all of you decided to help! So, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I need to thank you for today as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Of course!
Thank you as well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best as a class rep! And I look forward to working with you in the future...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...!
Asahina's got such a big smile on her face!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Seeing others smile like this really makes me so happy!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem so happy, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, today ended up being such a wonderhoy day!
